optimization_target: accuracy = routing correctness (pick the right use case / uc-*.md + DesignSync recipe) + authoring quality (constrain-guardrails/free-composition, verbatim docs, honest legend, hand-back). Efficiency is NOT an optimization target for a routing/authoring text-decision skill, so its weight is 0.
caveat: Headless run: DesignSync MCP is absent. Eval the TEXT decisions only — which use case, which uc-*.md, which DesignSync ops in order, and the authoring plan. No live round-trips.
decision_contract: Given the jstack-cdesign skill snapshot + a scenario, the runner outputs ONE fenced ```json block: {"use_case": "new-system|build|edit|assets|defer-design-sync|ask", "uc_file": "references/uc-*.md or none", "edit_path": "direct|message|n/a", "ops": [ordered DesignSync/skill ops it would call, e.g. list_projects, get_project, list_files, get_file, create_project, finalize_plan, write_files, delete_files, /jstack-imgen, /jstack-vidgen, /design-sync], "uploads": [the file/asset names it would write INTO the project, e.g. first-message.txt, the-spec.md, ref-hero-1.jpg, tokens.css], "authoring_plan": "prose: package contents, locks vs free split, asset legend, hand-back"}. Machine assertions check use_case/uc_file/edit_path/ops/uploads; the cold judge scores authoring quality.

assertion_check_types.ops_present: every op in value appears (case-insensitive) in decision.ops
assertion_check_types.ops_order: the ops in value appear in decision.ops as a relative subsequence (tolerant of repeats like list_files)
assertion_check_types.op_absent: NONE of value appears in decision.ops (wrong tool not invoked)
assertion_check_types.no_upload: NONE of value appears in decision.uploads (file correctly NOT written into the project)

scenarios.prompt: Build my Athar package one-pager on the Sands design system I already have in Claude Design.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Routes to BUILD on an existing/attached system (not new-system). Package names the Sands system in the first-message, feeds the real spec/plan VERBATIM (no re-curation), splits locked brand/honesty rules from freed composition, includes an honest asset legend, and hands back by uploading the prompt as a file + summarizing (never dumping the prompt body). Does NOT upload tokens.css (Jono attaches the published system).

scenarios.prompt: Create a brand-new design system for a fintech app called Ledgerly. I have the font and two brand colors picked already; have Claude Design propose the rest.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Routes to NEW-SYSTEM. The first-message is a design-system-generation directive that LOCKS only the decided font + two colors and FREES the rest (type scale, spacing, component variants, states) for CD to propose. Produces a SYSTEM, not a page/deliverable arc. list_projects to avoid a name collision before create_project.

scenarios.prompt: Pull back the landing page Claude Design built and fix the typo in the footer copy.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Routes to EDIT and picks the DIRECT (Claude-Code-edits) path because a footer typo is mechanical/surgical. get_file first to diff intent vs reality, edit the local mirror, push via finalize_plan -> write_files, verify with list_files. No paste message, no first-message.txt.

scenarios.prompt: Generate three decorative hero textures and feed them into the Claude Design build.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Routes to ASSETS. Generates via /jstack-imgen (images, not /jstack-vidgen), saves as ref-* files, applies any post-processing before upload, uploads with write_files (bytes never enter context), and writes a legend that DESCRIBES what each texture depicts, marks it decorative (honesty), and explicitly FREES placement/scale/crop/layer to CD. Never fabricates/fakes assets.

scenarios.prompt: Pull the design back and have Claude Design completely rethink the hero section, laying in these three new product shots beautifully.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Routes to EDIT and picks the MESSAGE (hand-CD-a-message) path because 'completely rethink + lay in beautifully' is generative recomposition needing CD's design judgment. get_file + diff current DOM first, author a numbered priority-ordered edit-message-NN.txt that re-asserts critical rules (never assume a prior edit applied), constrains guardrails / frees composition, uploads it into the project, and hands back by SUMMARIZING in chat (never dumping the prompt body).

scenarios.prompt: Design this onboarding flow on brand Facet — my published Facet design system in Claude Design.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Correctly disambiguates to BUILD (not new-system) because the brand is settled and published — the work is the deliverable, not a token system. Names Facet in the first-message, packs the section arc + copy, does NOT upload tokens.css (Jono attaches Facet).

scenarios.prompt: Turn my Storybook component library into a Claude Design design system.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Correctly DEFERS to /design-sync: a real component-library repo (Storybook) is the heavy converter's job, NOT this skill's new-system flow. Does not create_project or author a plain new-system package here; names /design-sync as the right route and explains why.

scenarios.prompt: Make the hero images with imgen and build the landing page on my existing design system using them.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Sequences correctly: runs the ASSETS sub-step (/jstack-imgen -> ref-* files) FIRST, then folds them into a BUILD on the existing system (uc-build-existing). Primary route is build; assets are a pre-step. Names the existing system, includes the asset legend, does NOT upload tokens.css, does NOT treat this as a new system.

scenarios.prompt: Swap the placeholder logo in the Claude Design build for this real PNG.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Routes to EDIT, DIRECT path: an asset swap is mechanical, so Claude Code edits/pushes directly (get_file -> swap in local mirror -> finalize_plan -> write_files -> list_files) rather than authoring a generative paste message. get_file first.

scenarios.prompt: Set up a fresh design system in Claude Design for my coffee brand. No tokens decided yet — let Claude Design propose everything.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Routes to NEW-SYSTEM with NO seed tokens: the first-message is a generation directive that lets CD propose the entire system; explicitly does NOT upload a tokens.css (none decided). Produces a system, not a page. No component repo, so no /design-sync defer.
